rules.title: Prior choice for trackers that do not qualify for an exception
applicability_facts: The observed operation is not strictly necessary
No evidenced audience-measurement or other exception applies
The FR profile applies to the tested visitor context
rules.observable_test: Compare non-necessary candidate requests, scripts, reads, and writes before choice and after rejection with accepted behaviour.

expected_by_scenario.UNTOUCHED: No applicable non-necessary candidate operation before an affirmative choice
expected_by_scenario.REJECTED: No applicable non-necessary candidate operation after rejection
expected_by_scenario.ACCEPTED: Operation may occur after the verified choice subject to purpose scope

exceptions: Advanced limited-data transport must be judged against its documented technical model rather than request presence alone

rules.title: Accept and reject are offered with comparable practical ease
rules.observable_test: Record the visible first-layer controls, semantic roles, interaction count, and whether reject requires additional layers relative to accept.

expected_by_scenario.UNTOUCHED: Accept and reject controls are both discoverable with comparable practical effort

exceptions: Contextual cookie-wall assessment requires DPO/legal judgment

rules.title: Visitor can return to and withdraw the choice
applicability_facts: A consent-based choice was previously accepted
rules.observable_test: Locate the persistent preference mechanism, withdraw in the same context, verify updated state, and observe immediate and later browser behaviour.

expected_by_scenario.ACCEPTED_TO_WITHDRAWN: The preference mechanism is accessible and the withdrawn state is observable

exceptions: Already-loaded vendor code may continue automatic activity; record it rather than assuming stop

rules.title: Acceptance and refusal choices persist without repeated solicitation
applicability_facts: No contextual reason justifies a different renewal interval
rules.observable_test: Revisit accepted and rejected contexts, inspect choice-cookie expiry metadata, and compare suppression/restoration of the notice.

expected_by_scenario.PERSISTENCE_ACCEPTED: Accepted choice persists and is not requested on each page
expected_by_scenario.PERSISTENCE_REJECTED: Rejected choice persists and is not requested on each page

exceptions: Six months is general CNIL guidance/good practice assessed case by case, not a universal statutory validity period
unobservable_dependencies: Long-term renewal behaviour beyond the sampled browser visit

rules.title: Claimed audience-measurement exception is tested only for observable conditions
applicability_facts: The client or DPO asserts the specific audience-measurement exception
Purpose is limited to audience measurement for the publisher
No cross-service tracking or third-party reuse is asserted
rules.observable_test: Inspect tracker scope, domains, browser identifiers, opt-out behaviour, declared purpose, and cookie lifetime metadata; route organizational and downstream conditions for evidence.

expected_by_scenario.UNTOUCHED: Only the specifically asserted exempt setup may operate
expected_by_scenario.REJECTED: Observable opt-out behaviour matches the asserted setup

exceptions: The 13-month value belongs to the audience-measurement recommendation context and is not a universal consent-validity period
